headline: Rogers State alone remain unbeaten
dek: Ouachita Baptist conceded three times in defeat by Dallas Baptist, the first goals they had let in this season, and Rogers State's draw at UT Tyler was the first match they have not won. Nine different players have now scored for Rogers State; no other programme has more than six.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Rogers State have outscored Newman, Northeastern State and Harding put together.

wire.line: Ouachita Baptist's unbeaten start ended at home to Dallas Baptist, the first goals they had conceded all season.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Against outside opponents the conference has scored thirty-eight goals and conceded thirty-three, yet has twelve defeats to eleven wins. Fort Hays State's draw with Fort Lewis is the third match this season that a programme in this conference has neither won nor lost.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Fort Hays State's seven goals have come from six different players, and they have yet to play away from home.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Len Valkema has scored twice for Fort Hays State from five shots, the first of their scorers to score more than once.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Harding have lost all three of their matches, every one of them at home, scoring once and conceding five. Reik Barrack is their only scorer.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Harding's goalkeeper Andrew Wagenblatt has made fifteen saves and conceded five.

last_match.line: Fort Hays State have still to play away from home; their first trip comes at West Texas A&M on Thursday.

next_match.line: Harding's first match away from home; they have lost every match so far, and Reik Barrack is their only scorer.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
